goal: Exempt a documents-only pull request from the agent work contract evidence pair, so a prose-only change can satisfy both the reviewer draw and the contract gate instead of neither.
prohibited_actions: Do not widen the documents-only classifier: rulebook prose (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, plan_*.md, skills, agents, commands) is never a document.
Do not let an unreadable or empty file list classify as documents-only; the gate must fail closed.
Do not weaken any other required check to make this pull request pass.
assumptions: This pull request is code, so the exemption it adds does not apply to itself; it carries a full evidence pair.
gh api --paginate --slurp returns one array per page, so a pull request over 100 files arrives as an array of arrays.
The workflow needs only pull-requests: read to list the changed files.
stop_conditions: Stop if the exemption would let a migration, script, workflow or configuration change bypass the contract gate.
Stop if the classifier cannot be proven to refuse a known-dirty case.
